description: Star Wars RPG — WorldObject, Collectible, and quest flag conventions. All worldObjects and collectibles in zone arrays must conform to these shapes.

WorldObject.id: string — globally unique slug across ALL zones and planets (used as key in completedInteractions Set when once=true)
WorldObject.x: integer — grid column (must be a floor tile in the zone's buildMap)
WorldObject.y: integer — grid row (must be a floor tile in the zone's buildMap)
WorldObject.label: string — short name shown above the object tile and in action log
WorldObject.description: string — text added to action log when player interacts; shown on first interaction OR every interaction if once=false
WorldObject.once: boolean — if true, interaction is recorded in completedInteractions and description is not shown again on subsequent visits; if false, description repeats every time

Collectible.id: string — globally unique slug across ALL zones and planets
Collectible.x: integer — grid column (must be a floor tile in the zone's buildMap)
Collectible.y: integer — grid row (must be a floor tile in the zone's buildMap)
Collectible.label: string — item name shown in action log on pickup
Collectible.reward: integer — credits added to player.credits on pickup; must be >= 0

QuestFlagConventions.storage: completedInteractions is a Set<string> stored in React state. IDs are added on first interaction with NPCs (after any choice) and on first interaction with worldObjects where once=true.
QuestFlagConventions.checking: Use completedInteractions.has(id) in dialogue choice rendering to gate follow-up content or block re-interaction.
QuestFlagConventions.naming: Use kebab-case slugs: planet-zone-entity-role. Example: coruscant-spaceport-guard-bribe, verdanth-ruins-ancient-terminal.
QuestFlagConventions.uniqueness: IDs must be unique across the entire PLANETS object — not just within a zone. Duplicate IDs cause silent state collisions.

OnceVsRepeat.once_true: Use for story beats, lore reveals, and NPC dialogue flags that should only fire once per playthrough. The object renders but interaction does nothing after the first time.
OnceVsRepeat.once_false: Use for ambient flavor objects, readable signs, and repeatable information sources. Every visit shows the description.
